properties.name: Uppingham curated visitor boundary
properties.methodology: Morphological closing of the preserved official built-up-area geometry using a 150 metre outward and inward buffer. This fills internal omissions for connected parks, river corridors and visitor green spaces without applying a general outward town buffer.

project.boundarySource: Curated Uppingham visitor boundary derived from ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024)
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides audit completed 2026-08-09. The unchanged ONS 2024 built-up area is the active inclusion boundary. Historic England designations and public current OpenStreetMap visitor facilities were filtered point-in-polygon. Rutland and Northamptonshire standalone attraction audit added 2026-08-09. These regional destinations sit outside the active town boundary, appear only on Home discovery, and do not alter the town tourist rating.

attractionGuide.heroAlt: Bright ink-and-watercolour illustration of Lyddington Bede House and its quiet village setting
attractionGuide.headline: A rare medieval palace survivor hidden in one of Rutland's loveliest villages
attractionGuide.intro: The Bede House is compact, atmospheric and best enjoyed as part of Lyddington itself. Its carved interiors and almshouse story reward a patient look.
attractionGuide.toilets: There are no visitor toilets at the Bede House.
attractionGuide.picnic: Picnics are welcome on the lawn, although tables and benches are not provided.
